title: Fibonotci
statementMd:
Fibonotci sequence is an integer recursive sequence defined by the recurrence relation

$*F*_{*n*} = *s*_{*n* - 1}·*F*_{*n* - 1} + *s*_{*n* - 2}·*F*_{*n* - 2}$

with

$*F*_{0} = 0, *F*_{1} = 1$

Sequence $*s*$ is an infinite and almost cyclic sequence with a cycle of length $*N*$. A sequence $*s*$ is called almost cyclic with a cycle of length $*N*$ if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/abdce465bcf8d0d338a86425f5fa2335716b3d7a.png), for $*i* ≥ *N*$, except for a finite number of values $*s*_{*i*}$, for which ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2ab32073499aaaf8b0d9c2b91c11a459e9232fd.png) ($*i* ≥ *N*$).

Following is an example of an almost cyclic sequence with a cycle of length 4:

s = (5,3,8,11,5,3,7,11,5,3,8,11,…)

Notice that the only value of $*s*$ for which the equality ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd0d4348232c2fbd13e29e43ab74867ddd55b748.png) does not hold is $*s*_{6}$ ($*s*_{6} = 7$ and $*s*_{2} = 8$). You are given $*s*_{0}, *s*_{1}, ...*s*_{*N* - 1}$ and all the values of sequence $*s*$ for which ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2ab32073499aaaf8b0d9c2b91c11a459e9232fd.png) ($*i* ≥ *N*$).

Find ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0201bb0e22294177386737ca97362911941b14b8.png).

## Input

The first line contains two numbers $*K*$ and $*P*$. The second line contains a single number $*N*$. The third line contains $*N*$ numbers separated by spaces, that represent the first $*N*$ numbers of the sequence $*s*$. The fourth line contains a single number $*M*$, the number of values of sequence $*s*$ for which ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2ab32073499aaaf8b0d9c2b91c11a459e9232fd.png). Each of the following $*M*$ lines contains two numbers $*j*$ and $*v*$, indicating that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/564d9a2c078730cf3e878e777c1048b58dd9fa77.png) and $*s*_{*j*} = *v*$. All j-s are distinct.

- $1 ≤ *N*, *M* ≤ 50000$
- $0 ≤ *K* ≤ 10^{18}$
- $1 ≤ *P* ≤ 10^{9}$
- $1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$, for all $*i* = 0, 1, ...*N* - 1$
- $*N* ≤ *j* ≤ 10^{18}$
- $1 ≤ *v* ≤ 10^{9}$
- All values are integers

## Output

Output should contain a single integer equal to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0201bb0e22294177386737ca97362911941b14b8.png).
statementZhMd:
Fibonotci 数列是一个由递推关系定义的整数递归数列：

$*F*_{*n*} = *s*_{*n* - 1}·*F*_{*n* - 1} + *s*_{*n* - 2}·*F*_{*n* - 2}$

其中

$*F*_{0} = 0, *F*_{1} = 1$

序列 $*s*$ 是一个无限且几乎循环的数列，其循环节长度为 $*N*$。如果对于 $*i* ≥ *N*$，除了有限个 $*s*_{*i*}$ 的值以外，都满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/abdce465bcf8d0d338a86425f5fa2335716b3d7a.png)，而对于这些有限个值满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2ab32073499aaaf8b0d9c2b91c11a459e9232fd.png)（$*i* ≥ *N*$），则称序列 $*s*$ 是循环节长度为 $*N*$ 的几乎循环数列。

下面是一个循环节长度为 4 的几乎循环数列的例子：

s = (5,3,8,11,5,3,7,11,5,3,8,11,…)

注意，序列 $*s*$ 中唯一不满足等式 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd0d4348232c2fbd13e29e43ab74867ddd55b748.png) 的值是 $*s*_{6}$（$*s*_{6} = 7$，而 $*s*_{2} = 8$）。给定 $*s*_{0}, *s*_{1}, ...*s*_{*N* - 1}$，以及序列 $*s*$ 中所有满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2ab32073499aaaf8b0d9c2b91c11a459e9232fd.png)（$*i* ≥ *N*$）的值。

求 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0201bb0e22294177386737ca97362911941b14b8.png)。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个数 $*K*$ 和 $*P*$。第二行包含一个数 $*N*$。第三行包含 $*N*$ 个以空格分隔的数，表示序列 $*s*$ 的前 $*N*$ 个数。第四行包含一个数 $*M*$，表示序列 $*s*$ 中满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2ab32073499aaaf8b0d9c2b91c11a459e9232fd.png) 的值的个数。接下来的 $*M*$ 行中，每行包含两个数 $*j*$ 和 $*v*$，表示 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/564d9a2c078730cf3e878e777c1048b58dd9fa77.png)，且 $*s*_{*j*} = *v*$。所有 j 互不相同。

- $1 ≤ *N*, *M* ≤ 50000$
- $0 ≤ *K* ≤ 10^{18}$
- $1 ≤ *P* ≤ 10^{9}$
- $1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$，对于所有 $*i* = 0, 1, ...*N* - 1$
- $*N* ≤ *j* ≤ 10^{18}$
- $1 ≤ *v* ≤ 10^{9}$
- 所有值均为整数

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0201bb0e22294177386737ca97362911941b14b8.png)。
